steps.job: The 24 owner decisions of section 5 as decision records (design/decisions/, carried in as nodes, unsigned), each on its default; the requirement rules of Y14-Y18 written as the developer's proposal. A design editor.

The data in: IGRF-14 (two independent copies, the ppigrf IGRF14.shc and pyIGRF14 igrf14coeffs.txt, checked equal), the IERS finals2000A and Leap_Second.dat (astropy-iers-data), CelesTrak SW-All (the spaceweather package), each read into an env node by tools/readers.py with its source and date. EGM2008 waits for its host (S12.8). A design editor.
The analytic oracles first, so later fixes are measured: TS1 (a)-(e), (g) and P4's integrator tests. Code only, in a worktree, in parallel with S12.2.
The truth's Earth frame: P8c, P9, then P2 and E4 (build A with EOP in the loop and the twin, the field's precession not counted twice), T5/E3's truth side, E14's epoch guard.

Onboard frames and the tracker: T5/E3's onboard side (IAU 2000B, dUT1 and pole as flight parameters) and E2 (aberration in the truth tracker, its correction onboard); C, Rust, twin; flight images resealed.
IGRF-14 as one table for the engine, both flight softwares and the twin; E10's radius; TS1(f) with 50 IGRF-14 points from two independent implementations.
The truth field's error (E5, dispersed per draw) and B interpolated between refreshes (E8).
EGM2008 20x20 (T4, P7) once its file can be fetched; the comments that claim tesserals corrected now.
Space weather: P1 (the World's drivers), P3 (3-hourly Kp, F10.7 lag), P6 and S11's survey finding (one activity table, the survey on DTM2020), T6/E9 (dated indices).
Drag and geometry: P10 (facets), E15 (wind), E11 (fine eclipse), E12 (mean Sun), P12 (mean elements), E13 (rings).
The propagator's two code fixes, P8a (no clone) and P8b (dense output), bit-identical. Code only, in a worktree, in parallel.
Requirements: Y14 (blanks refused by name, the new keys), Y15 (tip-off a range), Y17 (the profile named), Y18 (the factors stated).
Mass: Y3 (the coil from its copper bound, the growth allowance by maturity, the electronics line stated or refused).

The references: published vectors for the 31 used physics relations (PV), the reference ledger (V1) and its check that every environment model names its source and has a published-vector case: the done-when.
The environment scenarios: a scenario environment block (engine and twin), beta extremes, the activity levels and a storm, the seasons; golden rows added.
Regenerate, reseal, re-fly every case that moved (engine, campaigns, the design loop, soft OILS, the twin), the parity gates, golden.
Counts and tables (HEALTH, the ledgers, ENGINE_PARITY), the zip 1.x conversion.
The phase review and docs/S12_REPORT.md with the token ledger.
